# Lights Out

> Lights Out is a free daily F1 trivia race game in the browser. Each day there is a new race at a real circuit: one question sets your grid slot, then seven race-moment questions decide where you finish. Correct answers that fewer players would give ("rare" answers) gain more places.

- Free to play in any web browser; no download or account needed
- Available in English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Italian and German
- A new circuit every day, a 24-race season, points, standings and 28 achievements
- Unofficial fan game; not affiliated with Formula 1, the FIA or any team or driver

## Links

- [Play Lights Out](https://lightsoutgame.co.uk/): today's race
- [TikTok @lightsout.io](https://www.tiktok.com/@lightsout.io): daily F1 trivia videos
